step1.title: Hi. I'm glad you're here.
step1.body: Trinket is a quiet companion for getting things started — built around how an ADHD brain actually works. No streaks, no guilt, nothing to lose.
step1.disclaimer: Trinket supports getting started. It isn't a replacement for clinical care.

step2.heading: Anything been waiting?
step2.subcopy: One thing you've been circling. It'll just sit here quietly — no due date, no reminder.

step3.heading: This is your raccoon.
step3.body: It keeps you company while you work. It never asks anything of you — it's just glad to be around.
